name: comp_small_cap_catalyst_2026-09-25
strategy: Bet on dated, primary-sourced catalysts inside Oct 12-Nov 13 2026: FDA PDUFA dates (AGIO Nov 1, SMMT Nov 14, CAPR Nov 22, BBIO Nov 27, VRTX Nov 30, GILD Dec 23, CORT Dec 17, PRAX Dec 27), confirmed Q3 earnings (ASML Oct 14, TSM Oct 15, TER Oct 27, EVO.ST and SAAB-B.ST Oct 23, KOG.OL Oct 29, RHM.DE and HAG.DE Nov 5, ALL.AX Nov 12), and Hon Hai Tech Day Oct 30-31. Every name has a dated event in or near the window, and most carry positive revision_flow_90d. I would be wrong if a CRL or earnings miss hits several names at once, or if a macro shock compresses the whole book.
